text:
mira (DevEx): heads-up — I scanned the optimize-toolkit examples and found a handful of tiny-but-impactful issues (broken links, outdated SDK snippets for batching, and an old quant-profile table). I opened a tracking issue and slapped together a short bounty list for small PRs. idea: label as `docs:quickfix` + `optimize` so folks can pick them easily.

kevin (Eng-ML): thanks — can you paste the list here? I can take batching snippet updates and the KV prefetch example.

mira (DevEx): list below (short):
1) batching example in /sdk/python/optimize.md uses old `client.batch()` API (needs `client.optimize.batch()` in v2).
2) caching page links to internal protobuf example that was moved — broken link.
3) quantization profiles table still mentions q4_0 names that we've deprecated.
4) sample benchmark script uses sync loop causing weird latency numbers — swap to async streaming sample.
5) minor: small wording about "predictable throughput" that confuses Dedicated customers.

mira (DevEx): I created PR seeds in my fork for 1 and 3 with TODOs, left comments for maintainers. PR drafts: #6021 (batching snippet), #6022 (quant profile). They pass lint locally but need a docs build preview.

sara (Docs): I can shepherd link fixes and the wording change. For previews: run `make site-preview` + `mkdocs serve` locally, or push to my branch and I can run the CI preview. ci-bot: will post deploy preview link on push.

ci-bot: Note: docs build triggered on push to mira/fix-optkit-snippets. Preview URL will appear in this thread when ready. :robot_face:

kevin (Eng-ML): for batching snippet, here's the minimal replacement I used in an internal example — feel free to copy.

kevin (Eng-ML): ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
# optimize batching example (v2 sdk)
resp = client.optimize.batch(
    model="open-x-small",
    inputs=["short prompt 1", "short prompt 2"],
    max_tokens=64,
    batching={"min_batch_size":4, "max_latency_ms":50},
)
for r in resp.results:
    print(r.text)
```

mira (DevEx): perfect — can you add a note about `min_batch_size` tradeoff vs latency and link to the console SLO page? that helps docs readers tune.

kevin (Eng-ML): done in PR comment. Also added a one-line kv-prefetch tip for caching page: "prefetch common prefixes to warm KV cache during cold-starts".

tom (Product): quick ask — for quant profile table, can we add a small guidance row: "use q4_1 for production low-memory, q8_0 for latency-sensitive on dedicated" — product needs a short recommendation blurb for the migration guide. keep it opinionated but conservative.

mira (DevEx): agreed. I added a short migration checklist to #6022 with conservative mapping and a test plan (validate on a small traffic canary + token-cost comparison).

sara (Docs): I'll take the link repairs and wording tweak. Flagging one more micro task: update two example links in the sidebar that point to `optkit` instead of `optimize-toolkit`. I'll label that `docs:quickfix` as well.

mira (DevEx): allocation plan: kevin -> batching & kv example (#6021), sara -> links + wording, tom -> sign off on quant guidance, me -> merge PRs after preview checks + add small release note blurb. If anyone wants to pick one-off items ping here and I'll unassign.

kevin (Eng-ML): I'll aim to merge batching PR today. CI preview should catch any formatting.

ci-bot: Preview ready: https://deploy-preview-2371--redwood-docs.example.com/optimize-toolkit/batching (checks: mkdocs-lint OK, linkcheck: 1 warning).

sara (Docs): saw the preview — linkcheck warning is the moved protobuf example. I'm patching it now. Also fixed the sidebar links. Pushed branch `sara/linkfix-optkit` — CI preview: https://deploy-preview-2372--redwood-docs.example.com

mira (DevEx): merged #6021 after kevin's update and tests. Merged #6022 after tom's thumbs-up on the quant guidance. Minor release note included in `CHANGELOG.md`: "optimize-toolkit: updated batching SDK snippet, fixed caching link, clarified quant profiles."

tom (Product): approved the quant blurb in PR review. small ask for analytics: can we tag these snippets so we can A/B test later? maybe add `data-snippet-id` attribute in example HTML. not necessary for this quickfix but worth filing a follow-up.

mira (DevEx): filing follow-up issue: #6070 — "snippet telemetry hook for A/B tests".

kevin (Eng-ML): small follow-up: added a short note in the batching example on how to simulate load locally: `python -m http.server` + `wrk` example + env var to disable caching. helpful for SRE and docs reviewers.

sara (Docs): closing checklist: link fixes done, preview URLs saved in the PRs, CI clean. I'll mark the `docs:quickfix` issues as done.

mira (DevEx): thanks team. final ask: if anyone sees other tiny optimize-toolkit issues, drop them in the `#docs` channel with `optimize:` prefix so we can batch quickwins next week. :pray:
